pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM_MAG-Y-smaller-magnitude: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X); datatype-supported branch uses X=-3.0 and Y=2.0, initializes result to 9.0, and asserts result==2.0; unsupported branch skips. Mutate Y to 4.0 so the selected operand changes.

Mutate the operation to IEEE_MIN_MAG for a tie-sensitive check.
